note: When the text reader frees an attribute node with ID type, it calls xmlTextReaderRemoveID to detach it from the ID table
Raw pointer copy of attr->name to id->name without strdup; the name will be freed when the attr is freed, leaving a dangling pointer in the ID table
The attribute name is freed here (first free); id->name now points to freed memory
When xmlTextReaderFreeDoc frees the ID table, xmlFreeID tries to free id->name again causing heap-double-free
